module Clock
exports all
definitions
state Time of
  now : nat  -- 当前时刻，单位秒
  init t == t = mk_Time(0)
end
operations
  -- 时间前进一秒
  Tick: () ==> ()
  Tick() == now := now + 1;
end Clock

module Proc
exports all
definitions
state Procs of
  alive : bool  -- 进程是否存活
  init p == p = mk_Procs(true)
end
operations
  -- 模拟进程崩溃
  Crash: () ==> ()
  Crash() == alive := false;
  -- 模拟进程重启
  Restart: () ==> ()
  Restart() == alive := true;
end Proc

module Run
exports
  types RunId; struct RequestNo; struct Started; struct StartOutcome; struct StatusOutcome
  values RetrySeconds : nat1
  operations
    Start: RequestNo ==> StartOutcome;
    Status: RequestNo ==> StatusOutcome;
    Finish: RunId ==> ();
    Recover: RequestNo ==> ()
definitions
values
  -- 结果未知之后，两次找回之间至少相隔的秒数
  RetrySeconds : nat1 = 30;

types
  -- 一次运行的身份；提供方造出，使用方不读结构
  RunId = token;

  -- 调用方给出的请求号，从 1 开始；同一请求号代表同一次请求
  RequestNo = nat
  inv r == r > 0;

  -- 运行已经开始；调用方之后必须用 Finish 结束它
  Started ::
    run : RunId;  -- 结束时交回的身份

  -- Start 的结局：使用方必须区分已开始、被拒绝与结果未知；结果未知时改用 Status 找回
  StartOutcome = Started | <Rejected> | <Unknown>;

  -- Status 的结局：按请求号找回的运行，或确认它不存在
  StatusOutcome = RunId | <Absent>;

  -- 运行表：同一请求号至多对应一次运行，活着的运行都来自某个请求
state Runs of
  byRequest : map RequestNo to RunId  -- 请求号到它产生的运行
  live : set of RunId  -- 已开始、尚未结束的运行
  inv mk_Runs(b, l) == l subset rng b
  init r == r = mk_Runs({|->}, {})
end

operations
  -- 开始一次运行；同一请求号重复开始只产生一次运行
  Start(request: RequestNo) r: StartOutcome
  ext wr byRequest wr live
  post (is_Started(r)
          and (request in set dom byRequest~ => r.run = byRequest~(request))
          and byRequest = byRequest~ ++ {request |-> r.run}
          and live = live~ union {r.run})
       or ((r = <Rejected> or r = <Unknown>) and byRequest = byRequest~ and live = live~);

  -- 按请求号确认运行是否存在；只读，不改变运行表
  Status(request: RequestNo) r: StatusOutcome
  ext rd byRequest
  post (request in set dom byRequest and r = byRequest(request))
       or (request not in set dom byRequest and r = <Absent>);

  -- 结束一次运行；结束两次与一次效果相同
  Finish(run: RunId)
  ext wr live
  post live = live~ \ {run};

  -- 场景：开始的结果未知时，按请求号找回运行并结束它
  Recover: RequestNo ==> ()
  Recover(request) ==
    cases Start(request):
      mk_Started(run) -> Finish(run),
      <Rejected> -> skip,
      <Unknown> ->
        let found = Status(request) in
          if found <> <Absent> then Finish(found)
    end;
end Run

module Sched
exports all
definitions
state Queue of
  threads : seq of nat  -- 等待调度的线程编号
  init q == q = mk_Queue([])
end
operations
  -- 调度器选出下一个线程运行一个时间片
  Schedule: () ==> nat
  Schedule() == (let t = hd threads in (threads := tl threads ^ [t]; return t))
  pre threads <> [];
end Sched

module Ticket
exports
  types TicketId; struct Decision
  operations Open: Intent ==> TicketId; Decide: TicketId * Decision ==> DecideOutcome
definitions
types
  -- 一张单据的身份；由核心造出
  TicketId = token;
  -- 一次写意图；单据始终只有一个负责人
  Intent :: owner : Principal  -- 负责人
            basis : set of Position;  -- 依据的观察位置
  -- 负责人
  Principal = token;
  -- 观察位置
  Position = token;
  -- 审批人的决定
  Decision = <Approve> | <Reject>;
  -- 决定的结局
  DecideOutcome = <Prepared> | <Rejected> | <Conflict>;
state Tickets of
  open : map TicketId to Intent  -- 尚未关闭的单据
  closed : set of TicketId  -- 已关闭的单据
  inv mk_Tickets(o, c) == dom o inter c = {}
  init t == t = mk_Tickets({|->}, {})
end
operations
  -- 起一张单据
  Open(i: Intent) t: TicketId
  ext wr open rd closed
  post t not in set dom open~ union closed and open = open~ ++ {t |-> i};
  -- 对单据作决定；Prepared 与 Rejected 都关闭单据
  Decide(t: TicketId, d: Decision) r: DecideOutcome
  ext wr open wr closed
  pre t in set dom open
  post (r in set {<Prepared>, <Rejected>} and closed = closed~ union {t} and open = {t} <-: open~)
       or (r = <Conflict> and open = open~ and closed = closed~);
end Ticket

state.paragraph: 系统要高可用。
使用 SQLite 存储运行表。
当前代码在 src/run.ts 里先查后插，所以 Start 是幂等的。
上游在超时之后仍可能已经开始了运行（来源：上游接口说明）。所以 StartOutcome 有结果未知一支，调用方经 Status 找回运行。
在上游可用的情况下，调用方用同一个请求号重复调用 Start 时，系统只产生一次运行（来源：示例需求）。所以 Start 按 RequestNo 幂等。
单据要安全可靠。
我们用 Rust 实现，所以没有 HKT。
上游的写操作可能没有回执（来源：券商接口文档 §4.2）。所以写的结局有 Unknown 一支，永不重试。
同一账户上的写必须按顺序到达上游（来源：交易所规则）。所以写按账户排队。

module Run
exports
  types RunId; struct RequestNo; struct Started; struct StartOutcome; struct StatusOutcome
  values RetrySeconds : nat1
  operations
    Start: RequestNo ==> StartOutcome;
    Status: RequestNo ==> StatusOutcome;
    Finish: RunId ==> ();
    Recover: RequestNo ==> ()
definitions
values
  -- 结果未知之后，两次找回之间至少相隔的秒数
  RetrySeconds : nat1 = 30;

types
  -- 一次运行的身份；提供方造出，使用方不读结构
  RunId = token;

  -- 调用方给出的请求号，从 1 开始；同一请求号代表同一次请求
  RequestNo = nat
  inv r == r > 0;

  -- 运行已经开始；调用方之后必须用 Finish 结束它
  Started ::
    run : RunId;  -- 结束时交回的身份

  -- Start 的结局：使用方必须区分已开始、被拒绝与结果未知；结果未知时改用 Status 找回
  StartOutcome = Started | <Rejected> | <Unknown>;

  -- Status 的结局：按请求号找回的运行，或确认它不存在
  StatusOutcome = RunId | <Absent>;

  -- 运行表：同一请求号至多对应一次运行，活着的运行都来自某个请求
state Runs of
  byRequest : map RequestNo to RunId  -- 请求号到它产生的运行
  live : set of RunId  -- 已开始、尚未结束的运行
  inv mk_Runs(b, l) == l subset rng b
  init r == r = mk_Runs({|->}, {})
end

operations
  -- 开始一次运行；同一请求号重复开始只产生一次运行
  Start(request: RequestNo) r: StartOutcome
  ext wr byRequest wr live
  post (is_Started(r)
          and (request in set dom byRequest~ => r.run = byRequest~(request))
          and byRequest = byRequest~ ++ {request |-> r.run}
          and live = live~ union {r.run})
       or ((r = <Rejected> or r = <Unknown>) and byRequest = byRequest~ and live = live~);

  -- 按请求号确认运行是否存在；只读，不改变运行表
  Status(request: RequestNo) r: StatusOutcome
  ext rd byRequest
  post (request in set dom byRequest and r = byRequest(request))
       or (request not in set dom byRequest and r = <Absent>);

  -- 结束一次运行；结束两次与一次效果相同
  Finish(run: RunId)
  ext wr live
  post live = live~ \ {run};

  -- 场景：开始的结果未知时，按请求号找回运行并结束它
  Recover: RequestNo ==> ()
  Recover(request) ==
    cases Start(request):
      mk_Started(run) -> Finish(run),
      <Rejected> -> skip,
      <Unknown> ->
        let found = Status(request) in
          if found <> <Absent> then Finish(found)
    end;
end Run

工作者持有 JobLease 时进入热备态；LeaseKeeper 负责续租。
结果未知时运行进入悬挂区，由回收器定期扫描悬挂区并调用 Status。
每次 Start 都会生成一张启动凭证，Finish 时核销这张凭证。
调用方得到结果未知之后，两次调用 Run`Status 至少相隔 Run`RetrySeconds 秒。
Run 与 Attempt 运行在同一进程内；进程崩溃后，新进程按 Run`Runs.byRequest 接管尚未结束的运行。
每天生成一份日报（来源：示例需求），由 Report`Daily 走通。
单据进入冷冻期后，只有仲裁员能解冻。
Decide 之前先申请一把决策锁，拿到锁的审批人才能决定。
关闭的单据会被归档器每晚搬进冷库。
Ticket`Decide 返回 Conflict 时，审批人重新读取单据再作决定。
Ticket`Tickets.closed 里的单据不再被修改；这条记录在进程崩溃后由新进程原样读出。
每张单据的负责人由 Ticket`Intent.owner 给出，审批人可以与负责人不同。

end Run

module Ticket
exports
  types TicketId; struct Decision
  operations Open: Intent ==> TicketId; Decide: TicketId * Decision ==> DecideOutcome
definitions
types
  -- 一张单据的身份；由核心造出
  TicketId = token;
  -- 一次写意图；单据始终只有一个负责人
  Intent :: owner : Principal  -- 负责人
            basis : set of Position;  -- 依据的观察位置
  -- 负责人
  Principal = token;
  -- 观察位置
  Position = token;
  -- 审批人的决定
  Decision = <Approve> | <Reject>;
  -- 决定的结局
  DecideOutcome = <Prepared> | <Rejected> | <Conflict>;
state Tickets of
  open : map TicketId to Intent  -- 尚未关闭的单据
  closed : set of TicketId  -- 已关闭的单据
  inv mk_Tickets(o, c) == dom o inter c = {}
  init t == t = mk_Tickets({|->}, {})
end
operations
  -- 起一张单据
  Open(i: Intent) t: TicketId
  ext wr open rd closed
  post t not in set dom open~ union closed and open = open~ ++ {t |-> i};
  -- 对单据作决定；Prepared 与 Rejected 都关闭单据
  Decide(t: TicketId, d: Decision) r: DecideOutcome
  ext wr open wr closed
  pre t in set dom open
  post (r in set {<Prepared>, <Rejected>} and closed = closed~ union {t} and open = {t} <-: open~)
       or (r = <Conflict> and open = open~ and closed = closed~);
end Ticket

-- 场景：开始的结果未知时，按请求号找回运行并结束它
  Recover: RequestNo ==> ()
  Recover(request) ==
    cases Start(request):
      mk_Started(run) -> Finish(run),
      <Rejected> -> skip,
      <Unknown> ->
        let found = Status(request) in
          if found <> <Absent> then Finish(found)
    end;

-- 需要找回的运行：最后一条尝试是结果未知的运行；两个实现必须得出同一集合，所以写显式体
  Unresolved: seq of Entry -> set of RunId
  Unresolved(log) ==
    {log(i).run | i in set inds log & log(i).outcome = <Unknown> and not exists j in set inds log & j > i and log(j).run = log(i).run};

-- 场景：开始当天的日报运行，记下被接受的尝试，再结束它
  Daily: RequestNo ==> ()
  Daily(request) ==
    cases Start(request):
      mk_Started(run) -> (Record(mk_Entry(run, <Accepted>)); Finish(run)),
      others -> skip
    end;
